description: This file defines a TinyMCE plugin for inline popups, including plugin info, window management, and event handling for popup windows within TinyMCE editor.

classes.name: TinyMCE_Windows
classes.description: Class managing popup window instances, their positioning, resizing, and event handling within TinyMCE.

classes.name: TinyMCE_Window
classes.description: Represents an individual popup window with methods for focus, resize, move, close, and event handling.

methods.name: getInfo
methods.description: Returns plugin information such as name, author, URL, and version.

methods.name: openWindow
methods.description: Opens a new popup window with specified template and arguments.

methods.name: setWindowTitle
methods.description: Sets the title of a specified popup window.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the TinyMCE_Windows manager with settings and event listeners.

methods.name: getBounds
methods.description: Calculates and returns the viewport bounds for window positioning.

methods.name: clampBoxPosition
methods.description: Ensures window position stays within viewport bounds.

methods.name: clampBoxSize
methods.description: Ensures window size stays within minimum and maximum constraints.

methods.name: getParam
methods.description: Retrieves configuration parameters with default fallback.

methods.name: eventDispatcher
methods.description: Handles mouse and resize events for window interactions.

methods.name: updateClamping
methods.description: Updates window positions and sizes to stay within bounds.

methods.name: addEvent
methods.description: Adds event listeners with cross-browser compatibility.

methods.name: parseFeatures
methods.description: Parses window feature options from string to object.

methods.name: createFloatingIFrame
methods.description: Creates an iframe element for popup content with specified HTML.
